evidenceLayout: Per-plan evidence under tmp/ipd-s772/<planId>/ with final/ and attempt-<n>/ subdirectories. tmp/ is git-ignored and holds only data (logs, JSON, digests, PNG exports and comparison images); never authored source. Cargo output goes to target/ and the sidecar to apps/desktop/src-tauri/binaries/, declared as artifactRoots only by the plans that build them, which are ordered by dependsOn.

reviewContext.userProblem: An iPhone app design drawn with nodetto-cli 0.8.9 came out misaligned and sloppy. Defects D1-D10: ui.control ignores textAlign (D1); tabs ignore fill/stroke/accent and options are not styleable (D2); newline labels render monospace on one line (D3); geo rects under 3 units vanish (D4); no precise text layer, text.note ignores fontSize/fontWeight on update (D5); no icon element (D6); elements added inside a frame are not its children and nothing clips or snaps (D7); auto layout cannot be driven from the CLI (D8); prototype links are drawn across artboards with verbose labels and there is no prototype view, flow start, storyboard or presentation (D9); frame titles overlap content and there is no easy per-frame side-by-side comparison (D10).
requiredOutcomes: Decision 1: precise text layer on text.note (text:layer shape, no implicit padding, auto-width/auto-height/fixed, alignment, font size/weight, line height, letter spacing, color, single-line ellipsis, honored on add and update).

Decision 2: ui.icon element backed by vendored Lucide (ISC) with LICENSE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, name lookup from palette and `nodetto-cli shapes icon <query>`, size/color/stroke width, custom SVG path icons.
Decision 3: dividers and borders of any thickness >= 0.5 render; per-side borders and stroke alignment.

Decision 4: ui.control honors alignment, padding, font, color, radius, leading/trailing icons; tabs/segmented with underline and pill indicators, selected/unselected colors, per-option overrides; badges.
Decision 5: iOS component kit on the component/instance system with overridable properties, insertable by ios:<name> shape ID from palette and CLI.

Decision 6: frame auto-parenting (CLI add with parent or by containment), children move with frame, clip content, safe-area and layout-grid guides, iPhone presets including 390x844 and 402x874, titles above the artboard.
Decision 7: CLI layout/sizing (direction, gap, padding, alignment, hug/fill/fixed, absolute children), align, distribute, snap, and an 8/4 point desktop snap grid.

Decision 8: Figma-style prototyping concepts: hotspot or frame links with trigger/action (incl. back, swap-overlay)/animation, prototype view toggle with curved compact links, named flow starts, storyboard overview, desktop and HTML click-through presentation with persistent elements.
Decision 9: app-design lint (off-frame, text overflow/truncation, overlapping controls, off-grid, misaligned siblings, touch targets under 44 points).
Decision 10: export of all frames of a page as individual PNGs and a side-by-side comparison helper in CLI (`compare`) and desktop app.

Item 11: reproduction of the ten private reference screens built only through nodetto-cli operations into the operator-named git-ignored output directory, validate and app lint with zero findings, prototype links and one flow start, per-frame PNGs compared side by side with every reference screenshot (drift <= 4 points, correct icons, colors and type).
Generic iPhone sample under examples/ exercising the kit and prototype flows; CLI help and docs for AI agents.
TypeScript and native Rust CLI parity covered by mise run test-cli; final gates mise run verify, test-cli, build-cli and typecheck with no new failures versus the ipd-00 baseline.
nonGoals: No server, auth or deployment code (public repo).
No proprietary Figma assets or internal names; concepts only.
No schemaVersion bump or migration; all additions are optional fields plus the ui.icon type and two prototype action values.
No new native Rust host primitive is planned; parity comes from running shared TypeScript in the Boa-hosted CLI.
No push, merge, rebase, release, signing or upload; no changes to other repos or worktrees.
No tracked copy of any private reference material (names, texts, colors, screenshots).
constraints: Work only in /Users/taco/gits/tacogips/nodetto-app-iphone-design on feat/iphone-app-design from f59bef4; gitPush false.
Privacy: reference and reproduction directories stay under git-ignored tmp/; ipd-28 scans tracked and untracked files against tmp/ipd-s772/ipd-27-reproduction/private-terms.txt.
AGENTS.md: CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true, no emojis, stage by explicit path, no tool attribution in commits.
Existing documents stay valid and render byte-identically except the rows in the design's Accepted output changes table.
Problems outside a unit's writePaths are findings, never blockers; finding statuses use the fixed vocabulary.
Broad suites gate on no new failures versus the ipd-00 Baseline failures table with explicit excludes.
Visual evidence is mandatory for rendering/UI work: export PNGs with the built CLI and inspect them.
packages/core/src/index.ts and packages/ui-solid/src/index.ts are append-only shared files: re-read before writing, never reorder or remove lines.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Amendment 2026-11-10 round 1: blocked-wave-scope-or-contract operator amendment for session-772 wave 2 blockers: (a) ipd-01-ir-schema owns packages/ir/src/registry.test.ts and updates its complete ELEMENT_TYPES expectation to include ui.icon; (b) ipd-03-icon-data pins lucide-static 1.70.0 (the release already downloaded and recorded) and the generator accepts a `fill` attribute on child geometry elements only with the values `currentColor` or `none`; it stores a per-node `fill` flag, the markup renders `fill="currentColor"` nodes filled with the icon color (and `none` as unfilled, the default), and any other fill value still fails the script with the icon name; (c) ipd-00-baseline, ipd-02-text-measure, ipd-04-cli-edit-contracts and ipd-29-desktop-snap-grid are accepted dependencies whose code is already in the working tree; do not redo them.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Blocked plans: ipd-01-ir-schema and ipd-03-icon-data (gaps resolved: registry.test.ts ownership; lucide-static version pin and fill allowlist). ipd-01 could not pass `bun test packages/ir` because registry.test.ts asserts the full element-type list and was outside its writePaths. Lucide 1.70.0 (latest stable) has fill="currentColor" on a child of brain-circuit.svg (a filled dot); rejecting it would block the whole icon set, while a two-value fill flag keeps the strict allowlist and renders the icon as upstream intends. The run died at wave-2 reconcile from a network outage (ENOTFOUND), not a code failure.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: 2026-11-10 operator amendment round 13 (session-794 wave 1): ipd-24-parity-flows uses two edit-parity mechanisms. (1) Exact: harness compareFile, unchanged, for every edit whose input document uses fixed element ids and that creates no new element (update, move, align, prototype settings on existing ids), as ipd-23 does. (2) Normalized: for edits that create elements with generated ids (connect/prototype links, kit insertion, add), a test-local helper inside apps/cli/src/native-parity/app-design-flows.test.ts runs Bun and native exactly like compareFile, then replaces every generated id matching the ULID pattern /\b01[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{24}\b/ (and any short id prefix the CLI prints for it), and asserts equal exit codes, equal normalized stdout and stderr, and equal normalized documents. Step 5 IPD-R8 repair: the normalization does not depend on id order. Stdout and stderr mask every generated id and printed prefix to the single token <ID>. created arrays keep operation order (apps/cli/src/edit/batch.ts:301); any stdout list the CLI sorts by id is compared as a sorted masked list and recorded. Documents: parse each JSONL record, compute its masked canonical text (generated ids deep-replaced by <ID>, object keys sorted), and assign ordinals ID1..IDn by sorting on (masked page, memberIds containment depth, masked canonical text). The ordinals are used only to print the failure diff. Records that tie on all three keys are interchangeable (multiset semantics). Equality requires (a) equal sorted lists of masked canonical record texts and (b) equal sorted lists of reference edges maskedText(source)|fieldPath-with-array-index|maskedText(target). Pitfall: packages/io/src/jsonl/serialize.ts:146-152 sorts elements by page and then by element id. ULIDs minted in the same millisecond (packages/core/src/ids.ts:38-40, packages/core/src/editor/components.ts:162 and 289) therefore order randomly, so file order is not stable across hosts. Required plain-test self-checks: permuted generated ids with a different id-sorted line order -> equal; a changed non-id field (visual.x or a prop) on a minted element -> not equal; child memberships swapped between two distinct frames -> not equal. The test file is run three times, and each run must exit 0 with 0 fail and 0 skip. harness.ts, serialize.ts, ids.ts and engine source stay unchanged. PNG outputs keep the round-12 decoded RGBA comparison. Then complete the remaining DR-02 and clean-kit lint cases. Keep the ipd-24 work already in the working tree and continue from it.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The exact compareFile contract cannot hold for operations that mint ids independently in each runtime; ipd-23 passed by avoiding id-minting edits. A normalizer that only rewrites generated ids keeps every other byte under test, so real behavioral drift still fails.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: 2026-11-10 operator amendment round 14 (session-796 wave 1): Z-order comparison (operator round 14, binding): an element's fractional z-order `index` is randomized when the element is created, independently in Bun and native, so the normalized comparison must NOT compare raw `index` strings of elements created by the compared edit. Instead, per page, sort all elements by `index` (the engine's ordering) and assert the two hosts yield the same sequence of normalized element ids (ID placeholders and fixed ids). Raw `index` values of elements that already existed in the input document are compared exactly. Every other field is compared exactly after id normalization. Do not change engine or harness code.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Round 13's relative-order clause was lost when step 4 rewrote the plan, so ipd-24 compared randomized fractional indexes exactly and failed (2 of 4). Relative z-order of the normalized ids preserves the behavior under test (stacking order) without depending on random index strings. The rule is now in ipd-24's manifest acceptanceCriteria so a plan rewrite cannot drop it.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: 2026-11-10 operator amendment round 15 (session-797 wave 1): Generated-value comparison (operator round 15, binding; supersedes the narrower round-13 and round-14 wording): an edit may create values at random independently in Bun and native. In the normalized comparison: (1) every generated identifier (element ids, page ids, any ULID-like id and its printed short prefix) is replaced with ordinal placeholders by first appearance; (2) every generated ordering key, meaning element `index`, page `order` and any other fractional ordering key that the compared edit created, is not compared as a string; instead assert that both hosts give the same order of the normalized ids within that collection (pages sorted by `order`; elements per page sorted by `index`); (3) every value that already existed in the input document, and every other field, is compared exactly after normalization. Do not change engine or harness code.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Kit insertion also creates an iOS kit page whose `order` key is randomized independently per host; round 14 covered only element indexes. Generalizing to every generated id and ordering key keeps the behavior under test (which elements and pages exist, their content and their order) while ignoring only random tokens.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: 2026-11-10 operator amendment round 16 (session-799 wave 2): ipd-24-parity-flows is an accepted dependency. Determinism contract (operator round 16, binding for ipd-26, ipd-27 and ipd-28): documents built through nodetto-cli edit operations contain values generated at random (element and component ids, including the ids minted internally by kit insertion, and fractional ordering keys such as element `index` and page `order`). Repeated-run and Bun-versus-native determinism checks therefore use the round-15 generated-value comparison from ipd-24 (ids replaced by ordinal placeholders without numbering them by file position; generated ordering keys compared by relative order within their collection; every other field and every pre-existing value compared exactly), never raw byte equality. The committed example document is generated once and committed; its own regression test validates it, lints it with zero findings and renders it, but does not regenerate it byte for byte. Do not change engine id generation.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: ipd-26 found that two identical kit-insertion edits produce documents with 16 different generated ids, so an exact-byte determinism gate can never pass; ipd-27 (reproduction) and ipd-28 (finish) would hit the same wall, so the contract is set for all three at once instead of one round per unit.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: 2026-11-10 operator amendment round 17 (session-801 wave 1): Kit quality fix (operator round 17, binding): ipd-26-example-sample owns the iOS kit sources and tests (packages/core/src/kits/ios/bars.ts, content.ts, style.ts, insert.ts, props.ts, types.ts, kit-core.test.ts, kit-content.test.ts). (a) Round every computed kit child position and size to whole points, so no default kit instance or child is off the 1-point grid. (b) Size every default kit text box to fit its default text at its font, so no default kit instance reports note-overflow. (c) Afterwards every default kit component, inserted with its defaults into a 390x844 iPhone frame, lints with zero findings; add one regression test that inserts each kit component and asserts zero app-design lint findings. Do not change the lint rules. Update existing kit test expectations only where (a) or (b) changes a number. (d) The sample's prototype links target the specific child control (tab item, back button, send button) inside the kit instance, not the whole instance, and no link label overlaps another control. (e) Do not regenerate template HTML/CSS or other existing outputs beyond the design doc's accepted output changes; revert any unrequired regeneration. The round-16 determinism contract still applies.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: The generic sample's zero-findings lint gate failed with 19 warnings: 16 app-off-grid on children of kit instances (fractional coordinates from unrounded centering), 2 note-overflow in kit text boxes 18 high whose default text needs two lines, and 1 label collision in the sample's own links. The kit defaults are the defect and the reproduction (ipd-27) uses the same kit, so they are fixed once at the source.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: 2026-11-10 operator amendment round 18 (session-802 wave 2): ipd-26-example-sample is an accepted dependency. Layout rule (operator round 18, binding for every reproduction part): the reference screenshots are a 390x844 web view with no iOS status bar or home indicator. In each 390x844 iPhone frame: iOS status bar 0-47; top-anchored content shifted +47; bottom-anchored chrome (tab bar, floating action buttons, composer) shifted up by the 34-point home indicator, with the home indicator below it; the empty middle absorbs the difference. Where shifted top content would collide with bottom chrome (one screen in this set), that content area is a scroll region: put the content inside a frame clipped at the top edge of the tab bar (clip content on), so rows below the visible area are hidden as in the running app; floating action buttons stay as an intentional overlay above the content exactly as in the reference. Compare such a screen with two bands (top content above the clip line, bottom chrome) and record the number of clipped rows in the progress log by number only. The reproduction is split into sequential parts sharing one document: ipd-27a-reproduction-chrome (shared chrome + screens 01-03) -> ipd-27b-reproduction-detail (04-06) -> ipd-27c-reproduction-search-more (07-10) -> ipd-27-reproduction (links, flow start, full gates, all comparisons, copy). Keep the ipd-27 work already in tmp/ipd-s772/ipd-27-reproduction and continue from it.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: ipd-27 asked for an approved treatment of one screen where the +47/-35 shifts make the content overlap the bottom chrome; the running app scrolls that content under the tab bar with the floating buttons overlaid, so a clipped scroll region reproduces it faithfully. The single unit also ran out of continuations with 329 lint warnings and visible defects on five draft screens; ten screens are too much for one unit, so it is split by screen group.
